Game Overview

Bullet Army Run is a gun game built around command your Bullet Army through thrilling parkour arenas filled with tricky puzzles. Strategically navigate obstacles, skillfully collect bullets, and outsmart opponents. Master split-second decisions to expand your team at blue gates and avert disaster at red ones. Unleash your powerful bullet brigade and race towards victory!
